verdict.rationale: Otter's own docs directly claim this story: briefing documents are delivered before meetings with prior discussions, action items, and updates (otter-docs-53). This is supported by automatic capture of next steps from every meeting (otter-docs-3), organization by client for revisiting follow-ups (otter-docs-12), and calendar-scheduled meeting joins (otter-docs-17). Missing for 10: documentation of how briefs match past meetings by the same attendees, detail on how open threads are tracked across meetings, and independent or hands-on corroboration of pre-meeting briefs.
